verdict.rationale: Orrick documents a multi-jurisdiction venture practice: it claims to rank top 5 globally and #1 in Europe for VC financings, has venture teams in the UK, Germany and France, mentions France-side 'cross border M&A', and offers jurisdiction-specific tooling such as a German incorporation questionnaire, an EU Startup Health Check and global equity compensation 'across jurisdictions'. missing for 10: explicit documentation of flips/redomiciliations, specific coverage of international-investor or cross-border financing structures, independent or hands-on corroboration beyond the firm's own pages.
